fields.desc: Translation only: the inclusive invitation that precedes an action verb. Preserve its meaning; use natural localized phrasing; at most 24 characters.
Translation only: the action verb following the inclusive invitation. Preserve the action of creating; translate idiomatically, at most 24 characters.
The service or output the viewer would search for. Use a natural short query naming the new topic or need, e.g. Motion design for SaaS or AI video creation with TapVid; at most 64 characters.
One direct next action appropriate to the new topic. Use an imperative phrase, e.g. Book a project or Try TapVid today; no invented URL or offer; at most 48 characters.

meta.displays: Lead the viewer from an invitation and action through a search intent to one clear next step.
useWhen: Lead the viewer from an invitation and action through a search intent to one clear next step.
dontUseWhen: Use Brand06 for the closing identity.
